column1: # THE GOAL SHEET, leg 1: ours vs the libdeflate ALGORITHM (the in-tree ldx
# port of libdeflate v1.23, byte-identical L0-L9), as Ir/B under cachegrind.
# Both engines run through examples/ir_runner.rs on the same host in the same
# test invocation, so the RATIO is what is pinned and host drift cancels.
# ldx runs raw DEFLATE (no gzip framing/crc; that term counts against us).
# ldx is NOT the libdeflate C binary's cost: the rustc build of the port
# spends ~1.5x the C build's Ir (trainer 2026-08-04, text L1: ldx 62.02 vs
# libdeflate-gzip 40.60 Ir/B). Same-toolchain algorithm comparison only;
# margin > 1.0 = NAMED OPEN PERF GAP (goal is <=1.0): do not raise it, close it.
# margin <= 1.0 = held win; the ratchet only TIGHTENS, in the improving PR.
# ours_ir_per_b / ldx_ir_per_b are the seed-time absolutes (provenance, not asserted).
# Regenerate: UPDATE_IR_VS_LDX=1 cargo test --release --test ir_vs_ldx update_ldx_pins -- --ignored --nocapture
